subject: Coaching plan & clarity on expectations — 30-day milestones
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Coaching plan & clarity on expectations — 30-day milestones

Hi Dylan (cc: Priya, Laura),

Following our 1:1 this morning I wanted to put the coaching plan in writing so we have a shared record. The goal here is supportive — we want to give clear, measurable steps so you can get back on track without formal PIP escalation. Please read and reply with any clarifying points by EOD Friday.

Summary of concerns (what I've observed):
- Consistent missed delivery dates on Q4 feature rollouts (3 of last 4 sprints)
- Escalations where partner expectations were not proactively managed
- Gaps in PR quality leading to rework and slower review cycles

30-day objectives (specific & measurable):
1) Delivery predictability: Ship two feature slices end-to-end by 2027-01-06 with acceptance criteria agreed at sprint start.
2) Partner communication: Proactively send weekly status updates to account teams and flag blockers within 48 hours.
3) Code quality: Reduce post-merge rework to <10% of your PRs; include a short QA checklist in every PR description.

Support and checkpoints:
- Weekly 1:1s (Rishi + Dylan) on Wednesdays, 30 min (first check-in: 2026-12-10)
- Biweekly review with Laura (engineering manager) to assess cross-team dependencies
- HR (Priya) will be included for process and documentation; please complete the HR acknowledgement form attached.

Deliverables to me and to Laura by 2026-12-22: updated sprint plan with tasks, examples of two improved PRs, and a one-page recap of partner comms templates you will use.

Attachments: coaching_checklist.xlsx (action items), last_30_days_metrics.pdf (delivery metrics we've been tracking)

If after 30 days there is insufficient progress we will move to a formal PIP conversation. The goal with this note is transparency and to make expectations actionable.

Thanks — I know you want to succeed here and we'll be hands-on.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Coaching plan & clarity on expectations — 30-day milestones

Thanks Rishi — I appreciate the concrete plan and the time today. A couple quick clarifications: 
1) The two feature slices — can we confirm those are the telemetry dashboard fixes and the token-batching change? I want to make sure scope is aligned.
2) For the PR checklist, I'll paste a template in the shared doc by tomorrow.

I agree to the weekly 1:1s. I'll review the attached metrics and return the HR acknowledgement once I understand the documentation path.

—Dylan

Date: 2026-12-10T09:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Coaching plan & clarity on expectations — 30-day milestones

Dylan — thanks for the quick reply and for taking ownership. Confirming scope: telemetry dashboard fixes + token-batching optimization (small scope, no new API surfaces). Laura and Vivek — looping you both in to ensure we can remove hidden blockers and surface any infra support needs.

Updated checkpoints after today's 1:1:
- 2026-12-15: draft sprint plan with task-level owners (Dylan)
- 2026-12-22: demo of the two feature slices in staging (Dylan)
- Weekly status email to account teams, cc: Laura (starting 2026-12-11)

I uploaded a shared doc with a simple tracker: https://drive.redwood.ai/docs/rishi/dylan-30d-coaching — please add comments there rather than long email threads so we keep the timeline clear.

If at any checkpoint we do not see the agreed outputs we'll have an immediate calibration call. Priya — can you confirm what documentation HR needs to keep this as an informal coaching record?

Thanks,
Rishi

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-12-12T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Coaching plan & clarity on expectations — 30-day milestones

Thanks for including HR. A few process notes from my side: 
- Please use the HR acknowledgement form (attached: hr_acknowledgement_form.pdf) — this is standard for coaching notes and confirms receipt of expectations.
- Send weekly status snapshots to hr-peopleops@redwood.ai (subject line: "Coaching: Dylan Brooks — week ending YYYY-MM-DD").
- I'll create a confidential coaching file in our HR system once the acknowledgement is returned; that file is used for tracking only and does not automatically trigger a PIP.

If Rishi wants, I can also schedule a short alignment sync with Dylan mid-plan to ensure he has the resources he needs (15 minutes).

Priya Natarajan
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
